annotations.title: Create a Zotero note from Markdown

description: Create a note in Zotero from Markdown: a child note under an item (`parent_item`), or a standalone note (optionally filed in `collections`). Markdown: headings, paragraphs, bullet and numbered lists, **bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~, `code` and fenced code blocks, [links](https://...), > blockquotes, tables, horizontal rules, and $inline$ or $$display$$ math, all stored as the note editor's own HTML. Raw HTML is shown as text, not interpreted. Cite a library item with its key in brackets: [@ABCD2345], [@ABCD2345, p. 12], [see @ABCD2345; @WXYZ6789, pp. 3-5]. Each becomes a real Zotero citation (clickable in Zotero, live when the note is added to a Word document), and a key that names nothing refuses the write. Zotero titles a note by its first line; pass `title` to put a heading there. To add to a note that exists, use zotero_append_to_note; to rewrite one, zotero_replace_note. Writes go to the running Zotero desktop app (Zotero 10+) for every library it holds, otherwise to the cloud Web API (requires ZOTERO_API_KEY with write access).

cite.description: Turn [@ITEMKEY] references into Zotero citations (default true). false leaves them as plain text.

collections.description: Collection keys to file a standalone note in (from zotero_list_collections). A child note lives with its parent, so this is refused together with `parent_item`.

library_id.description: Numeric id of the library to address, e.g. 5234875 for a group (zotero_groups lists the ids you can reach). Omit to use the configured default library; an id given without library_type is read as a group id.

library_type.description: Which library to address: "user" (a personal library) or "group" (a shared group library). Omit to use the library this server is configured for. "group" on its own is refused: pass library_id with it.

parent_item.description: Key of the regular item (paper, book, ...) the note belongs to. Omit for a standalone note.

tags.description: Tags to put on the note, e.g. ["literature-note"].

title.description: A heading placed at the top of the note, which Zotero then shows as its title. Omit to let the first line of `markdown` be the title.

name: zotero_create_note

citations.description: How many [@KEY] groups became Zotero citations.

failed.description: One entry per object the write could not land; absent or empty when all of them did.

code.description: Zotero status for this object, e.g. 400 or 412.

index.description: Position of the failed object in the request.

key.description: Item key, when the failed object named one.

libraryVersion.description: The library's Last-Modified-Version after this write.

parentItem.description: The item the note was attached to, for a child note.

target.description: Where the write went: "local" (Zotero desktop local API), "desktop" (connector protocol) or "cloud" (Zotero Web API).
